entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-25
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Validation] Add Validate() that only runs synchronous ValidationAttribute #67421
  • HttpSys AsyncAcceptContext can repeatedly fail after stale NativeOverlapped is freed #67419
  • ValidationsGenerator doesn't unwrap array types #67412
  • SignInManager.PasskeySignInAsync throws InvalidOperationException when session challenge has expired instead of returning SignInResult.Failed #67410
  • SingalR 8.* version has vulnerable package ws 7.5.10 #67407

Closed

  • Quarantine ServerRoutingTest.CanNavigateToQueryStringPageWithNoQuery #66195
  • Support modeling unions are responses in OpenAPI documents #58810
    .NET 11 Planning
  • MapRazorComponents unexpectedly requires antiforgery middleware #51981
    Backlog
  • Quarantine TestServerTests.LongPollingWorks (ObjectDisposedException in DefaultHubDispatcher) #67348
  • Rework `Antiforgery` usage in aspnetcore template #67084
    11.0-preview7
  • Blazor analyzer public `[Parameter]` code fix fails to replace multiple modifiers #67364
    11.0-preview7
  • InvalidCastException when using [AsParameters] with primary constructor record that has ValidationAttribute on constructor parameters #65348
    .NET 11 Planning
  • Normalize backslashes in PathDecoder #66665

PullRequests

Created

  • Add AddHealthChecks(IServiceCollection, Action<HealthCheckOptions>) overload #67420
    area-healthchecks, community-contribution
  • Improve QuickGrid diagnostics for mismatched GridSort types #67413
    community-contribution
  • Adopt the PAT pool for agentic workflows #67411
  • Harden SignalR stateful reconnect. #67409
  • Update ws package version to 7.5.11 #67408
    community-contribution
  • Fix InputBase retaining invalid parsing state and stale validation messages after Value change #67406
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #67405
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:

Merged

  • [test-quarantine] Unquarantine ServerRoutingTest.CanNavigateToQueryStringPageWithNoQuery #67417
    test-failure
  • [test-quarantine] Unquarantine IIS StartupTests (dotnet/runtime#126925) #67418
    test-failure
  • [test-quarantine] Re-Quarantine IIS.NewHandler.FunctionalTests.StartupTests.SetCurrentDirectoryHandlerSettingWorks #67416
    test-failure, re-quarantine
  • Unquarantine SignalR long-polling TestServerTests #67414
  • Remove redundant app.UseAntiforgery() from Blazor Web templates #67119
    area-mvc
  • Fix Blazor [Parameter] public code fix handling of multiple access modifiers #67365
    community-contribution
  • Pin Node.js to 24.14.1 to avoid v24.15.0+ native crash #67402
    11.0-preview7
  • Fix InvalidCastException when retrieving attributes for PropertyAsParameterInfo #67284
  • Add [StringSyntax(Json)] to string parameters that accept JSON #66358
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • Make PathString.StartsWithSegments treat backslash also as a boundary #67093
    area-networking
  • ValidationsGenerator: Allow validating internal types #67399

Updated

  • Generate test certificates at runtime #67325
  • Fix culture persistence to not have public API #67367
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview7
  • Add For Loop Analyzer for variables used in closures. #67228
    area-blazor, analyzer, community-contribution
  • Circuit can be paused by Blazor when inactivity is detected #67098
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview6
  • Use IValidatableTypeInfo.TryFindProperty instead of ValidationOptions.TryGetValidatablePropertyInfo #67333
  • Improve Blazor async form validation #67323
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview6
  • Fix validation for null nullable parameters in minimal APIs #67395
    community-contribution, area-minimal, feature-validation
  • Fix passkey login broken by SSR client-side validation #67258
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview6
  • Make MVC API analyzers detect undocumented status codes in conditional returns #66775
    area-mvc, community-contribution
  • Use more performant span APIs #67150
    community-contribution, area-networking
  • Add IEndpointMetadataProvider to UnauthorizedHttpResult #65611
    community-contribution, feature-openapi, area-minimal
  • CacheBoundary support for Blazor #65772
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview7
  • Fix null reference issue caused by validation exception when circuit is disposed #67146
    area-blazor
  • Enhance InputSelect tests by adding edge case scenarios #67015
    area-blazor
  • QuickGrid: Add active filter indicator for ColumnOptions button #67314
    community-contribution
  • Add AddHealthChecks(Action<HealthCheckServiceOptions>) overload #66774
    area-healthchecks, community-contribution
  • Surface dotnet-getdocument output to Terminal Logger #66421
    area-commandlinetools, community-contribution
  • Add InactiveClass parameter to NavLink #66365
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • Add warning and code fix suggestion for non-public `[JSInvokable]` methods #67137
    area-blazor, analyzer, community-contribution
  • Add IsValid property to ValidationStateChangedEventArg #67362
    community-contribution
  • Synchronize form reset behavior with EditContext and InputBase #67379
    community-contribution
  • Add OnPageChanging and OnPageChanged event support to Paginator #67380
    community-contribution
  • Fix misleading docs for ActionLink and PageLink #66453
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
